short.q: Describe the role of basso continuo in Baroque music.
short.model: A keyboard (harpsichord or organ) plays chords and a cello or double bass plays the bass line, giving the harmonic foundation.

short.q: State the difference between glissando and pizzicato.
short.model: Glissando is a slide through the notes between two pitches; pizzicato is a plucked string.

short.q: List four instruments of a salsa band.
short.model: Any four: congas, bongos, timbales, clave, güiro, cowbell, piano, bass, trumpets, trombones.

short.q: What is word-painting? Give an example.
short.model: Music that imitates the meaning of the words, e.g. a rising line on the word heaven.

short.q: Describe the use of multi-tracking in popular music.
short.model: Separate parts are recorded on different tracks and then mixed together, allowing layering and editing.
